candidate.user_submission: The child is 18 months old and has fever. The temperature measured is 38.0°C. The fever has lasted for 2 days. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. There is no cough or difficult breathing. There is no diarrhoea. The child has no ear problem. There is no generalized rash. There is no obvious cause of fever present. There is no identified bacterial cause of fever. The area is in a high malaria risk. Malaria test is available and the result is positive. There is no cough with measles. The child has not had measles within the last 3 months. The child does not have red eyes. There is no runny nose. The child does not have stiff neck.
